verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for an observability/logging SaaS like Better Stack, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents choosing a storage region or data residency. The EU, US West and Asia/Pacific mentions refer to on-call schedule time zones, not where data is stored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
